headline: Approved tax abatements for multiple properties, denied others, and approved exemption applications for Fiscal Year 2026.
summary: The board accepted the minutes from the January 15, 2026 meeting. It voted to abate taxes on numerous properties for Fiscal Year 2026 and voted to deny abatements for a separate list of properties. The board also reviewed and approved new Statutory Exemption Applications and new Community Preservation Act Exemption Applications for Fiscal Year 2026.
decisions: Accepted the minutes of the previous meeting held January 15, 2026.

Voted to abate Fiscal Year 2026 taxes on a list of properties, including $1,747.98 on 39 Central St, $1,081.00 on 9 Seward Ave, $951.28 on 81 Lothrop St, $2,263.74 on 20 Brimbal Hill Dr, $233.50 on 118 Hull St, $1,714.55 on 4 Nelson Ave, $11,485.27 on 108 Sohier Rd, $8,575.57 on 106 Sohier Rd, $1,435.57 on 86 Hale St, $412.94 on 9 Crescent Ave, $4,801.80 on 2 Bridle Path Ln, $341.60 on 45 Rantoul St Unit 301, $474.56 on 8 Peabody Ave, $216.20 on 31 Budleigh Ave, $360.65 on personal property at 900 Cummings Center Dr Ste 101T, $3,367.32 on 890 Hale St, $888.58 on 11 Quincy Park, $2,402.21 on 116-128 Rantoul St Unit 1, and $754.03 on 62 Putnam St.

Voted to deny Fiscal Year 2026 abatements for properties at 37 Haskell St, 31 Abbott St, 27 Ocean St, 114 Valley St, 7 Pickman Rd, 79 Rantoul St, 375 Rantoul St Unit 2, 66 Paine Ave, 50 Balch St, 75 Sam Fonzo Dr, 20 Prince St, 1 Curtis Pt, and 498 Rantoul St.
Reviewed and approved new Statutory Exemption Applications for Fiscal Year 2026.
Reviewed and approved new Community Preservation Act Exemption Applications for Fiscal Year 2026.
